author: Unity
description:
This is the second video in our series on Unity Industry Cloud, a collaborative 3D platform designed for teams to create, review, and deliver immersive experiences. In this video, you'll see how Unity Asset Manager facilitates efficient team collaboration on 3D assets, including version management and preparing assets for final production.

Topics covered in this video:
✅ Adding members and assigning roles
✅ Inspection and annotation tools
✅ Modifying assets and version comparison
✅ Search and discovery

Unity Asset Manager is available with both the Unity Industry and Unity Studio subscriptions. Unity Studio is a no-code, web-based editor that empowers anyone within an organization to create and share in 3D. Unity Industry includes the Unity Editor and provides advanced visualization, simulation, AR/VR, and interactive applications to accelerate innovation and improve workflows. 

Sign up for the 30-day free trial of Unity Studio: https://on.unity.com/UnityStudio_Cloud
